title: Thailand map: which pins?
kaylee: She can tell each place on the Thailand map at a glance, without reading.
questions: Which one: 1 picture pins, 2 friends on clouds, or 3 rides?

pitches.title: 1 Picture pins
pitches.finger: The pins you have, with a drawing inside: Agong, a baby elephant, Nan's pink mushroom, the otter.

pitches.title: 2 Friends on clouds
pitches.finger: Who she'll meet: Agong, the elephant, Moon the sun bear and the jet ski otter wave from a puff of cloud.

pitches.title: 3 Rides
pitches.finger: What she'll ride: the tuk-tuk, the longtail, the Pajero and the jet ski, showing off on a toy turntable.
